scope: Additive cell-type-annotation-transfer intake (issue #349), same dated lane, three same-day/next-review passes. Pass 1: two scTab deep-ensemble uncertainty ROC-AUC values (0.782, 0.891), corrected for averaging order/ensemble terminology/training-setting claim. Pass 2: Abdelaal et al. 2019 Baron Human INTRA-dataset rejection-option evidence ingested (new source + dataset + protocol + 3 methods + 4 configurations + 4 evaluations + 7 results); scArches's ~84% accuracy re-checked and held unresolved. Pass 3 (this review): Abdelaal source retrieved_at corrected to a real re-fetch timestamp (2026-10-06T23:28:54Z UTC, byte-identical, replacing a bounded-window estimate); retrieved bytes archived as a committed gzip artifact (artifacts/abdelaal-2019-pmc6734286-fulltext.xml.gz); the three unlabeled-percentage results' metric_direction changed from 'lower' to 'unknown' (schema's own three-value contract) with an explicit F1/rejection-tradeoff note; the 8,569-cell Table 2 figure is now explicitly distinguished from a confirmed per-classifier scored denominator. limitations: Automated source review is not qualified human scientific review or experimental reproduction.

scTab's 0.782 (absent-type detection) and 0.891 (known-type error detection) are two distinct comparisons from the same uncertainty mechanism (predicted probabilities averaged across the 5-model ensemble first, then uncertainty = 1 minus the maximum of that averaged probability; ensemble_size, not n_runs) and must never be combined or described interchangeably. Neither establishes cross-study or cross-platform transfer; exact Group 2/Group 3 denominators are not stated in the retrieved main text.

Abdelaal et al. 2019's four median F1 values and three unlabeled percentages are INTRA-dataset (same single Baron Human dataset, stratified 5-fold cross-validation); they do not establish cross-study or cross-platform transfer. The source's own genuine inter-dataset experiments (Fig. 4, Fig. 5) are not ingested.

Percentage-unlabeled results carry metric_direction: "unknown" (not "lower"): this is a coverage/rejection-rate tradeoff against the same classifier's own median F1, not a standalone performance figure with one universal direction.
8,569 cells is the Table 2 Baron Human dataset-size figure, not independently confirmed as the exact number of cells scored for any individual classifier's result.

scArches's ~84% accuracy figure is NOT ingested: its accuracy-formula denominator (whether cells labelled "unknown" count against accuracy or are excluded) is not stated for the figure that reports it (Fig. 4c); the only explicit formula found applies to a different, narrower-population figure (Supplementary Fig. 17, which explicitly excludes the unseen tissue). No record for scArches exists in this release.

This pass adds no change to any existing record, source, or mapping outside this use case's own three new mappings; it adds new catalogue records and new mappings only, under the same already-reviewed dated lane.
